newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan sugar output put at 2.366 mln T by May 15.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan sugar output put at 2.366 mln T by May 15.

text.p: The private Pakistan Sugar Mills Association said on Saturday sugar output had reached 2.366 million tonnes by May 15, compared to 2.439 million tonnes at the same time a year ago.

The association had earlier said 2.637 million tonnes of sugar had been produced by April 30. It did not explain the the apparent revision of its figures. It said mills were expected to produce a total of 2.38 million tonnes in 1996/97 (July-June), down from 2.47 million in 1995/96 and 3.0 million in 1994/95.
Dealers had bought 1.333 million tonnes, or 56.37 percent, of this year's output and the remaining 1.032 million tonnes was still at the mills, the association said.
